https://mastodon.social/@JakobFel@retro-.text: These days, GOG has an "additional contribution" option when purchasing anything. Today, I tried something new: I've decided that, going forward, I'll be rounding up all of my orders to the nearest whole dollar. I'm not buying much these days (for various reasons) but rounding up contributes a few cents each time. That's not a huge contribution but if we all started doing that to our orders, that still helps to support GOG's game preservation efforts over time. #gog #drmfree #RetroGames
